decision: EVENT ROLE CONTRACT REVISION READY FOR V1.2 AUTHORIZATION
v11_event_semantics: broad neutral EVENT with no lifecycle subtype or role validation

strategy_review.new_entity_types: rejected; intrinsic taxonomy loses attributed conflict representation
strategy_review.entity_role_field: rejected; intrinsic global-looking metadata and new canonical field
strategy_review.has_event_role_relation: recommended; assertion-attributed role using existing structures
strategy_review.separate_lifecycle_record: rejected; unnecessary record and serialization surface

role_contract.qualifier_rule: exactly one EVENT_ROLE qualifier and no other qualifier
role_contract.attribution_rule: role relation must be referenced by a valid assertion
role_contract.observation_role: not added; V1.1 OBSERVED assertions and OBSERVED_BY already represent observation

reference_validation.conflicting_roles: retain attributed conflict; required support may still exist

scope: role belongs to resident scoped EVENT; no global merge or cross-scope trust inference
